sources.title: Albeu - North Macedonia presents 2027 draft budget
Republika - Ongoing infrastructure projects estimated at 10 billion EUR

en.summary: The Mickoski government's 2027 draft budget spends MKD 440.4bn (about €7.2bn, +4.8%) with a deficit of 3.5% of GDP. It allots MKD 40.8bn to capital investment, MKD 220.8bn to pensions and social transfers and 2% of GDP to defence; ongoing infrastructure projects are estimated at about €10bn.
en.leader: Prime Minister Hristijan Mickoski / President Gordana Siljanovska-Davkova / Finance Minister Gordana Dimitrieska-Kochoska
agenda: 2027 spending €7.2bn, deficit 3.5%, gradual consolidation
Capital investment MKD 40.8bn (infrastructure, public services)
More social transfers, including 4.8% higher pensions
Defence at 2% of GDP and NATO obligations
Progress in EU accession talks
